nodes.name: LeaveController.java
nodes.summary: Leave REST controller: endpoints for createLeaveRequest, getMyLeaveRequests, getLeaveRequestDetail, cancelLeaveRequest, handleLeaveRequest (approve/reject by manager/HR), getTeamLeaveRequests, getLeaveBalance, getLeaveTypes. Role-based access control.

nodes.name: CreateLeaveReqRequest.java
nodes.summary: Create leave request DTO: leaveTypeId, startDate, endDate, startTime, endTime, reason, attachmentUrl. Validation for date ranges and overlapping requests.

nodes.name: HandleLeaveReqApiRequest.java
nodes.summary: Handle leave request DTO: action (APPROVE, REJECT), comment. Used by manager/HR to process pending leave requests.

nodes.name: LeaveFilterRequest.java
nodes.summary: Leave filter request DTO: userId, departmentId, leaveTypeId, status, dateFrom, dateTo, page, size, sortBy, sortDir. Used for paginated leave queries.

nodes.name: HrLeaveResponse.java
nodes.summary: HR leave response DTO: requestId, userId, employeeCode, fullName, department, leaveType, startDate, endDate, duration, status, reason, approver, approvedAt. Full HR view.

nodes.name: LeavePreviewResponse.java
nodes.summary: Leave preview response DTO: leaveType, startDate, endDate, duration, conflicts (overlapping requests), balanceImpact. Pre-submission validation preview.

nodes.name: ManagerLeaveResponse.java
nodes.summary: Manager leave response DTO: requestId, userId, employeeCode, fullName, leaveType, startDate, endDate, duration, status, reason. Manager view for team requests.

nodes.name: StaffLeaveResponse.java
nodes.summary: Staff leave response DTO: requestId, leaveType, startDate, endDate, duration, status, reason, attachmentUrl. Employee self-view.

nodes.name: LeaveRequest.java
nodes.summary: LeaveRequest JPA entity: id, userId, leaveTypeId, startDate, endDate, startTime, endTime, duration (hours), status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED), reason, attachmentUrl, approverId, approvedAt, createdAt, updatedAt. Supports half-day and hourly leave.

nodes.name: LeaveRequestStatus.java
nodes.summary: LeaveRequestStatus enum: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED. Workflow states for leave request lifecycle.

nodes.name: LeaveException.java
nodes.summary: Leave exception: extends RuntimeException with error codes (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, OVERLAPPING_REQUEST, INVALID_DATE_RANGE, LEAVE_TYPE_NOT_FOUND, REQUEST_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION, APPROVER_REQUIRED). Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: HandleOvertimeReqApiRequest.java
nodes.summary: Handle overtime request DTO: action (APPROVE, REJECT), comment. Used by manager to process overtime requests.

nodes.name: OvertimeFilterRequest.java
nodes.summary: Overtime filter request DTO: userId, departmentId, status, dateFrom, dateTo, page, size, sortBy, sortDir. Paginated overtime queries.

nodes.name: OvertimeWorkTimeRequest.java
nodes.summary: Overtime work time request DTO: workDate, startTime, endTime, reason, attachmentUrl. Validation for business hours and maximum daily overtime.

nodes.name: HrOvertimeResponse.java
nodes.summary: HR overtime response DTO: recordId, userId, employeeCode, fullName, department, workDate, startTime, endTime, duration, status, reason, approver, approvedAt. Full HR view.

nodes.name: ManagerOvertimeResponse.java
nodes.summary: Manager overtime response DTO: recordId, userId, employeeCode, fullName, workDate, startTime, endTime, duration, status, reason. Manager view for team.

nodes.name: StaffOvertimeResponse.java
nodes.summary: Staff overtime response DTO: recordId, workDate, startTime, endTime, duration, status, reason, attachmentUrl. Employee self-view.

nodes.name: Holiday.java
nodes.summary: Holiday JPA entity: id, name, date, isRecurring, description. Used for overtime calculation (holiday pay rates) and leave balance.

nodes.name: OvertimeRecord.java
nodes.summary: OvertimeRecord JPA entity: id, userId, workDate, startTime, endTime, duration (hours), status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED), reason, attachmentUrl, approverId, approvedAt, createdAt, updatedAt. Daily overtime record.

nodes.name: OvertimeRecordStatus.java
nodes.summary: OvertimeRecordStatus enum: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED. Workflow states for overtime approval.

nodes.name: OvertimeException.java
nodes.summary: Overtime exception: extends RuntimeException with error codes (EXCEEDS_DAILY_LIMIT, EXCEEDS_MONTHLY_LIMIT, INVALID_WORK_TIME, OVERLAPPING_RECORD, RECORD_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION, APPROVER_REQUIRED, HOLIDAY_CALCULATION_ERROR). Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: HolidayRepository.java
nodes.summary: Holiday repository: JPA repository with findByDate, findByDateBetween, findRecurringHolidays. Used for overtime pay calculation and leave balance.
